notes: A worked connector config for `python -m dskit.onboarding register-source vendor --connector localfiles --config @examples/onboarding/source-localfiles.json` — the source's NAME is the CLI argument; this file is only the config object, validated default-deny against the connector's spec() (a document-level `notes` like this one is always allowed). Point `path` at any directory of *.csv / *.jsonl files; each file becomes a stream named by its stem. `effective_field` names the column carrying each row's ISO effective_date — the world-time half of the bitemporal pair (ADR-0014). Add "forecast_streams": ["outlook"] to DECLARE a stream's records as forecasts (segregated into forecasts/, never inferred from dates). For bulk sources, add the reserved block "storage": {"payload_codec": "gzip", "observations_codec": "gzip"} to land streams compressed (ADR-0036; both default "none", and the connector never sees the block).
